musical_direction: Straight piano; languid, dreamy, freely flowing and jazz-inflected; sweet melancholy, warm isolation, independent voices, unequal phrases, tied suspensions and gently resolving sevenths and ninths. Velvet Estuary remains the reference; Clair de Lune informs atmosphere and spaciousness without quotation. From Op. 21, progressively more experimental and advanced: richer jazz harmony, irregular metre, rhythmic independence, wider registers and evolving contrapuntal textures. Retain warmth, lyricism and tonal points of return.

reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
